name: drevantix
description: Drevantix – vehicle tracking platform, customer portal and company website

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client exec tsc -b
